attributes.powers:
For your exploration, encounter the top card of the siege deck as if it were the top card of your location deck. After the encounter, unless it is defeated or displayed, shuffle it back into the siege deck.

When you would examine cards in a location deck, you may examine them in the siege deck instead.

When you are dealt damage, if the damage is not reduced to 0, banish the top card of your location deck and each unoccupied location deck; when a location deck has no cards, that location closes automatically.

corrections.corrected_text: On the support card Defensive Stance, change “When you would explore, instead encounter the top card...” to “For your exploration, encounter the top card...”.
corrections.issue: When Defensive Stance is in play, does the card I encounter count as an exploration?
